guidelines: 24-bit WAV at the session's native sample rate
Every stem consolidated from bar 1 beat 1 so they line up on import
Master bus limiters, clippers and bus compression switched off
Label stems clearly and include the tempo and key in the folder name
Include a rough mix or reference bounce so I can hear where you are going
